release_notes: Buyer Log 7.0.191 TEST: INTAKE no longer loses dimension values (blank Dönem Tanım / UrunKlasmanTanım rows) after saving the view; saved field identities, filter values and labels are preserved and snapshots are remapped to current field IDs. Filter value lists no longer report a misleading 'live source unavailable' message. New weighted-average summarization: SEZON OTB (REZERV DAHİL) subtotals and grand total are weighted by Güncel Alım Bütçe. 'Check for Updates' menu label is unified for all users.
